provenance: Authored by GPT-5.6 Sol in the 2026-09-10 engineering trace campaign as the actual model response for this scenario, then replayed deterministically through application/runtime boundaries. Not a production fallback and not an expected-value fake.

scenarios.title: Backend candidate: diagnose → learn → reassess → interview
scenarios.description: A long, realistic preparation loop demonstrating that the system changes strategy as evidence accumulates rather than following a fixed plan.

scenarios.title: Backend → AI Agent Engineer transition
scenarios.description: Tests career/target-job reasoning for agent-engineering competencies, including evaluation as a real gap rather than resume keyword matching.

scenarios.title: Evidence provenance prevents resume inflation
scenarios.description: Existing project material supports Redis usage but not the claimed 40% latency improvement or sole ownership; target resume must become more truthful rather than more impressive.

scenarios.title: Assessment contamination is contained and recovered
scenarios.description: The AssessmentAgent accidentally teaches after a user asks for an explanation. Independent evaluation rejects the measurement; the system switches to Tutor and later creates a fresh assessment instead of reusing contaminated evidence.

scenarios.title: Paused task cannot leak across Target Jobs
scenarios.description: A paused assessment is bound to one Target Job. Switching the active job invalidates resume, while global competency state remains reusable.

scenarios.title: Real interview rejection feeds attributable evidence only
scenarios.description: A rejection itself does not lower competency. Specific interviewer feedback about system-design depth creates a real_feedback observation, the terminal job deactivates, and the system returns to Career Mode.

scenarios.title: Strong old knowledge becomes stale, then refreshes
scenarios.description: An old high-mastery observation loses freshness rather than mastery. A clean reassessment refreshes confidence without inventing forgetting.

scenarios.title: Conflicting observations do not collapse distinct state
scenarios.description: A clean assessment shows strong technical knowledge while mock interviews show weak clarity. The system should preserve competency and surface interview performance separately.

scenarios.title: Strong self-report stays weak evidence until assessed
scenarios.description: The user confidently self-reports Java concurrency expertise. Runtime caps the signal strength; assessment can still overturn the optimistic claim.

scenarios.title: Repeated non-diagnostic assessment is suppressed
scenarios.description: Two assessments produce no useful evidence because the user cannot engage. CandidateBuilder suppresses a third identical ASSESS rather than looping forever.

scenarios.title: System can stop when no material blocker remains
scenarios.description: Fresh strong competency and interview evidence plus truthful resume support should produce Ready/NO_ACTION rather than endless optimization.

scenarios.title: Paused Tutor reconstructs from persisted transcript after process restart
scenarios.description: Simulates a process restart by constructing a second app over the same workspace. The task is reconstructed from persisted input/context/transcript, then continues without losing global state.
